name: #Mousou Otome Game Kouryaku Taishouka Keikaku: Uso to Boku to Date Gokko
original_name: #妄想乙女ゲー攻略対象化計画　ウソとぼくとデートごっこ
source:
The protagonist is a second-year high school student who is a member of the Student Council.
One day, under the instructions of the Student Council President, he goes on a date with his classmate and art club member, Otome Natsuo!
While he thought it would be a fun "pretend date," he ends up delving into the secrets of the Otome family!?
translation:
主角是一名高中二年级学生，也是学生会成员。
某天，在学生会长的指示下，他和同班同学兼美术部成员乙女夏男去约会！
虽然他以为这会是一次有趣的“假装约会”，但他最终却探究了乙女家族的秘密！？
